column2: [intro]
In my head, an idea sparks,
So I sit down at the keyboard,
I press the keys, I create,
But it all seems impossible to complete.
I need to clear space, make room,
And then I’m happy, there’s space to bloom,
I add my new elements, without pause,
But in just a few minutes, it’s like an avalanche.
By connecting just two little things,
The music takes on a whole new swing,
But after a few days of this, I’m worn out,
I need a break, a win, no doubt.
